name: Hospital readmissions
description: Follow up with patients most likely to come back within 30 days.
label: Readmissions
metric_line: Readmissions reached by follow-up in your top 10%

words.future: patients will be readmitted within 30 days
words.event: the patient came back within 30 days

intake_goal: We want to know which discharged patients are likely to come back within 30 days so the care team can follow up first.
replies: We want to know which discharged patients are likely to come back within 30 days so the care team can follow up first.
The care team can call about 10% of discharged patients.
A readmission costs about 15,000 dollars, a follow-up call about 25. About 2,000 discharges a month.
